title: RSNA Knee Meta Fold Checkpoints V3
subtitle: consensus-label checkpoints from rsna-knee-full-consensus
description: Five-fold DINOv2 ViT-S checkpoints trained on RSNA knee abnormality detection with deterministic mode and consensus label confidences (stevenleehans llm_labels_v4_blend as second opinion, non-gold disagreement cells downweighted). Mean fold CV 0.7946 (fold0 0.7919, fold1 0.7923, fold2 0.7890, fold3 0.7904, fold4 0.8092), superseding rsna-knee-meta-folds-v2 (CV 0.7872). Preproc marker rgb01, img-size trained at 224, evaluated at 336 by infer.
